name: Somchai Charoen
bio:
Somchai Charoen’s journey into motorsport was somewhat unexpected. A seasoned communications professional, he initially worked in Thailand's burgeoning tourism sector, crafting narratives and managing public perception. His passion for racing was ignited during a chance encounter with a local racing team seeking media exposure. Captivated by the speed and precision of the sport, he transitioned his skills, bringing a unique perspective to motorsport PR. 

At Trackhouse Racing, Somchai champions a holistic approach to public relations, believing in the power of storytelling to connect fans with the team. He emphasizes authenticity and transparency, fostering genuine relationships with media outlets and influencers. His strategic vision and unwavering commitment to building a positive brand image make him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring Trackhouse Racing remains a prominent figure in the motorsports landscape.

 Somchai is known for his ability to bridge cultural gaps and connect with diverse audiences, crafting compelling narratives that resonate globally. His experience in crisis communication and reputation management has made him a trusted advisor to drivers and team management alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with slight graying at the temples
physical.description: A man of medium height with a warm smile and a confident posture.
